howToPlay: Use the Mecha to secure space and escape when necessary. Utilize the basic attack to pressure opponents and trigger the Super to cause chaos on the battlefield. Switch between forms strategically using gadgets to either heal the Mecha or launch it forward.
gears: Equip HEALTH for increased survivability, SHIELD for extra protection, or GADGET COOLDOWN to use abilities more frequently.
trait: This brawler suits players who enjoy a tank role and tactical management of a secondary health pool.
